definitions: The distribution of a workload across multiple computing resources, such as servers or network links, to optimize resource utilization, maximize throughput, minimize response time, and avoid overload.
A technique used in computer networking to distribute incoming network traffic across a group of backend servers, ensuring no single server becomes a bottleneck.
examples: Effective load balancing is crucial for high-traffic websites.
The system uses hardware load balancing.
They implemented software load balancing for their new application.
